prompt: Red finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy
irony: Red schemes to keep the lost puppy with a shortcut, but she only keeps a friend by giving the puppy back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Red and friends play in the sunny park when a small shivering puppy whimpers under the slide.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Red wants to keep the puppy and tells Green a quick shortcut story to hide it from Mum.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares the kids to keep the puppy secret while it sneezes and misses its owner.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids gather round the shivering puppy and sing the lost-puppy hook together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Red hides the puppy in a toy box with treats, but Green worries and the puppy wails louder.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The puppy grabs Black's shoe and drags the kids giggling tumbling across the wet grass.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids gather round the tired puppy and sing the lost-puppy hook together again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White holds the trembling puppy and knows she cannot fix fear, only comfort it.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White decides to hug the puppy close and search the park for its owner, and Red nods along.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The kids sing the hook, then White turns it: giving back brings a friend.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The hook echoes in the sunny park as the owner hugs the puppy, and Red waves to a new playmate.
